Prefer :registers with no arguments (full list; press Space / j if -- More -- appears). :reg + means :reg then <Space> then + then Enter. The unnamed register’s name is a single ASCII double-quote — the Ex line is :reg " (space, one double-quote, Enter), which is easy to mistype; :echo string(vim.fn.getreg('"')) and :echo string(vim.fn.getreg('+')) in nvim always show something ('' means empty). To force text into the buffer: :put =vim.fn.getreg('"') then :put =vim.fn.getreg('+'). With unnamedplus, + should match the yank; confirm with Cmd+V / Ctrl+V outside the editor.

Fix: set clipboard=unnamedplus / vim.o.clipboard = 'unnamedplus' in config, or yank explicitly with "+y.
